divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: store-wide path searches and text scans (several of which time out and are rerun in shards) surface the patent matters; file listings of the candidates pick out complaints, status reports and closure papers; reads of those documents separate the two cases with current status reports from dismissed, settled, pre-suit or prosecution matters; the answer counts two, and check stages re-verify paths and the second case's lack of a closing document. Reviews mainly pushed for coverage and re-verification; none moved the count.
